oauth.clientIdHint: The Google Client ID ends in .apps.googleusercontent.com

settings.hint: Enter the ID of the manager account, such as 123-456-7890
Enter up to 50 Google Ads account IDs, such as 123-456-7890, separated by commas

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: List the Google Ads accounts this MCP can use: the ones the connected Google sign-in opens directly, and the client accounts of those that are manager accounts. Campaigns live in client accounts, never in a manager account. Each account comes with its currency and time zone, which every amount and date of the other tools follows.

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.description: List the campaigns of an account with their status, type, bidding strategy, daily budget, and figures over a period: impressions, clicks, cost, click-through rate, average cost per click, conversions, and conversion value. Removed campaigns are left out. Amounts are in the account's currency, which each result names.

customer_id.description: Google Ads account ID, such as 123-456-7890, as returned by list_accounts.

status.description: Only campaigns with this status. ALL is enabled and paused ones.

date_range.description: The days the figures cover, in the account's time zone. LAST_n_DAYS ranges end yesterday.

start_date.description: First day of a custom period, such as 2026-01-01. Set it with end_date.

end_date.description: Last day of a custom period, such as 2026-01-31. Set it with start_date.

tools.name: get_campaign
tools.description: Get one campaign in full: settings, budget, bidding, networks, the locations and languages it targets, its negative keywords, and its ad groups. Criterion IDs are the ones update_campaign_targeting removes. Amounts are in the account's currency, which each result names.

customer_id.description: Google Ads account ID, such as 123-456-7890, as returned by list_accounts.

campaign_id.description: Campaign ID, as returned by list_campaigns.

tools.name: list_ad_groups
tools.description: List the ad groups of an account, or of one campaign, with their status, default bid, and figures over a period. Removed ad groups are left out. Amounts are in the account's currency, which each result names.

customer_id.description: Google Ads account ID, such as 123-456-7890, as returned by list_accounts.

campaign_id.description: Only what belongs to this campaign.

date_range.description: The days the figures cover, in the account's time zone. LAST_n_DAYS ranges end yesterday.

start_date.description: First day of a custom period, such as 2026-01-01. Set it with end_date.

end_date.description: Last day of a custom period, such as 2026-01-31. Set it with start_date.

tools.name: list_ads
tools.description: List the ads of an account, a campaign, or an ad group with their texts, landing page, status, Google's review of them (approval, policy topics, ad strength), and figures over a period. Removed ads are left out. Amounts are in the account's currency, which each result names.

customer_id.description: Google Ads account ID, such as 123-456-7890, as returned by list_accounts.

campaign_id.description: Only what belongs to this campaign.

ad_group_id.description: Only what belongs to this ad group.

date_range.description: The days the figures cover, in the account's time zone. LAST_n_DAYS ranges end yesterday.

start_date.description: First day of a custom period, such as 2026-01-01. Set it with end_date.

end_date.description: Last day of a custom period, such as 2026-01-31. Set it with start_date.

tools.name: list_keywords
tools.description: List the keywords of an account, a campaign, or an ad group with their match type, status, bid, quality score, and figures over a period. Negative and removed keywords are left out: get_campaign lists the negative keywords of a campaign. Amounts are in the account's currency, which each result names.

customer_id.description: Google Ads account ID, such as 123-456-7890, as returned by list_accounts.

campaign_id.description: Only what belongs to this campaign.

ad_group_id.description: Only what belongs to this ad group.

date_range.description: The days the figures cover, in the account's time zone. LAST_n_DAYS ranges end yesterday.

start_date.description: First day of a custom period, such as 2026-01-01. Set it with end_date.

end_date.description: Last day of a custom period, such as 2026-01-31. Set it with start_date.

tools.name: list_search_terms
tools.description: List what people actually searched for before seeing the ads of an account, a campaign, or an ad group, with the figures of each search term over a period. Use it to find keywords to add and negative keywords to exclude. Amounts are in the account's currency, which each result names.

customer_id.description: Google Ads account ID, such as 123-456-7890, as returned by list_accounts.

campaign_id.description: Only what belongs to this campaign.

ad_group_id.description: Only what belongs to this ad group.

date_range.description: The days the figures cover, in the account's time zone. LAST_n_DAYS ranges end yesterday.

start_date.description: First day of a custom period, such as 2026-01-01. Set it with end_date.

end_date.description: Last day of a custom period, such as 2026-01-31. Set it with start_date.

tools.name: get_performance
tools.description: Get the figures of an account, of its campaigns, or of its ad groups over a period, optionally broken down by day, week, month, device, or network. Rows without any impression are left out of a breakdown. Amounts are in the account's currency, which each result names.

customer_id.description: Google Ads account ID, such as 123-456-7890, as returned by list_accounts.

segment.description: Break each row down by this. Left out, a row covers the whole period.

campaign_id.description: Only this campaign. Not with the account level.

date_range.description: The days the figures cover, in the account's time zone. LAST_n_DAYS ranges end yesterday.

start_date.description: First day of a custom period, such as 2026-01-01. Set it with end_date.

end_date.description: Last day of a custom period, such as 2026-01-31. Set it with start_date.

tools.name: list_assets
tools.description: List the assets of an account: images with their size in pixels and a link to view them, and the texts, sitelinks, and callouts ads can show. Image asset IDs are what create_responsive_display_ad and add_campaign_images take.

customer_id.description: Google Ads account ID, such as 123-456-7890, as returned by list_accounts.

type.description: Only assets of this type. ALL is every type listed here.

tools.name: list_changes
tools.description: List what was changed in an account lately, newest first: when, by whom, from which tool (the Google Ads website, the API, a script, a recommendation), on which campaign or ad group, and which fields. Google keeps 30 days of changes, and lists a change a few minutes after it was made.

customer_id.description: Google Ads account ID, such as 123-456-7890, as returned by list_accounts.

days.description: How many days back to look, today included.

tools.name: search_locations
tools.description: Find the locations Google Ads can target by name: countries, regions, cities, postal codes. Returns the location IDs that create_campaign and update_campaign_targeting take, with how many people each reaches.

names.description: Place names to look for, such as ["France", "Lyon"].

country_code.description: Only places in this country, as a two-letter code such as FR.

locale.description: Language the names are written in, as a two-letter code such as fr.

tools.name: generate_keyword_ideas
tools.description: Get keyword ideas from Google's Keyword Planner for seed keywords, a web page, or both: each idea with its average monthly searches, competition, and the range of bids that reach the top of the page. Google only answers this for Cloud projects with Basic or Standard access. Amounts are in the account's currency, which each result names.

customer_id.description: Google Ads account ID, such as 123-456-7890, as returned by list_accounts.

keywords.description: Words or phrases to start from.

url.description: A web page to draw ideas from.

location_ids.description: Only searches from these locations, by the IDs search_locations returns.

language.description: Language of the searches, as a code such as en, fr, or pt_BR.

tools.name: run_query
tools.description: Run a read-only Google Ads Query Language (GAQL) query for what the other tools do not cover, such as conversion actions, recommendations, audiences, or figures by hour. Rows come back as Google returns them: field names in camelCase, identifiers and counts as text, and amounts ending in Micros in millionths of the account currency (2500000 is 2.50). A query cannot change anything.

customer_id.description: Google Ads account ID, such as 123-456-7890, as returned by list_accounts.

query.description: A GAQL query, such as: SELECT campaign.name, metrics.clicks FROM campaign WHERE segments.date DURING LAST_7_DAYS AND campaign.status = 'ENABLED' ORDER BY metrics.clicks DESC

tools.name: create_campaign
tools.description: Create a Search or Display campaign with its own daily budget, bidding strategy, and targeting. It is created paused unless status says otherwise, and needs an ad group, ads, and for Search keywords before it can show anything: add them with create_ad_group, add_keywords, and create_responsive_search_ad or create_responsive_display_ad, then enable it with set_campaign_status. Amounts are in the account's currency.

customer_id.description: Google Ads account ID, such as 123-456-7890, as returned by list_accounts.

name.description: Campaign name. No other campaign of the account may have it.

channel.description: SEARCH shows text ads on Google search results. DISPLAY shows image ads on websites and apps.

daily_budget.description: Average amount to spend a day, such as 25 or 12.5. Google may spend up to twice that on a day, and never more than 30.4 times it in a month.

bidding_strategy.description: MAXIMIZE_CLICKS needs no conversion tracking. MAXIMIZE_CONVERSIONS and MAXIMIZE_CONVERSION_VALUE need conversions to be tracked. MANUAL_CPC bids what the ad groups and keywords say.

max_cpc.description: With MAXIMIZE_CLICKS only: the most a click may cost.

target_cpa.description: With MAXIMIZE_CONVERSIONS only: the cost per conversion to aim at.

target_roas.description: With MAXIMIZE_CONVERSION_VALUE only: the return on ad spend to aim at, as a ratio. 4 is 400%.

location_ids.description: Locations to show the ads in, by the IDs search_locations returns. Left out, the campaign targets every country.

languages.description: Display campaigns only: languages of the people to reach, as codes such as en, fr, or pt_BR. Left out, every language.

start_date.description: First day the campaign may run, such as 2026-01-31, in the account's time zone.

end_date.description: Last day the campaign runs. Left out, it has no end.

status.description: ENABLED lets the campaign spend as soon as it has approved ads.

search_partners.description: Search campaigns only: also show the ads on the sites of Google search partners.

display_network.description: Search campaigns only: also show the ads on the Google Display Network.

eu_political_ads.description: Declares that the campaign carries political advertising aimed at the European Union, which Google then does not serve there.

tools.name: update_campaign
tools.description: Change the settings of a campaign: its name, its bidding strategy and target, its start and end dates, and for a Search campaign the extra networks it shows on. Only what you pass is changed. Its budget is changed with update_campaign_budget, its status with set_campaign_status, and its targeting with update_campaign_targeting. Amounts are in the account's currency.

customer_id.description: Google Ads account ID, such as 123-456-7890, as returned by list_accounts.

campaign_id.description: Campaign ID, as returned by list_campaigns.

bidding_strategy.description: New bidding strategy. Left out, a target passed below applies to the current one.

max_cpc.description: With MAXIMIZE_CLICKS only: the most a click may cost.

target_cpa.description: With MAXIMIZE_CONVERSIONS only: the cost per conversion to aim at.

target_roas.description: With MAXIMIZE_CONVERSION_VALUE only: the return on ad spend to aim at, as a ratio. 4 is 400%.

search_partners.description: Search campaigns only: show the ads on the sites of Google search partners.

display_network.description: Search campaigns only: show the ads on the Google Display Network.

tools.name: set_campaign_status
tools.description: Enable, pause, or remove a campaign. An enabled campaign spends its daily budget as soon as it has approved ads. A removed campaign cannot be restored.

customer_id.description: Google Ads account ID, such as 123-456-7890, as returned by list_accounts.

campaign_id.description: Campaign ID, as returned by list_campaigns.

tools.name: update_campaign_budget
tools.description: Set the average amount a campaign spends a day. Google may spend up to twice that on a day, and never more than 30.4 times it in a month. Amounts are in the account's currency.

customer_id.description: Google Ads account ID, such as 123-456-7890, as returned by list_accounts.

campaign_id.description: Campaign ID, as returned by list_campaigns.

daily_budget.description: New average amount to spend a day, such as 25 or 12.5.

tools.name: update_campaign_targeting
tools.description: Change who a campaign reaches: add or remove locations, add or remove languages (Display campaigns only), add negative keywords that keep its ads away from searches, and remove any criterion by the ID get_campaign lists.

customer_id.description: Google Ads account ID, such as 123-456-7890, as returned by list_accounts.

campaign_id.description: Campaign ID, as returned by list_campaigns.

add_location_ids.description: Locations to add, by the IDs search_locations returns.

remove_location_ids.description: Locations to stop targeting. An excluded location is not one: remove its exclusion with remove_criterion_ids.

add_languages.description: Display campaigns only: languages to add, as codes such as en or fr.

add_negative_keywords.description: Searches the campaign must not show for. A negative keyword takes no max_cpc.

remove_criterion_ids.description: Criteria to remove, such as negative keywords, by the criterion IDs get_campaign returns.

tools.name: create_ad_group
tools.description: Create an ad group in a campaign, to hold ads and, in a Search campaign, the keywords they show for. Amounts are in the account's currency.

customer_id.description: Google Ads account ID, such as 123-456-7890, as returned by list_accounts.

campaign_id.description: Campaign ID, as returned by list_campaigns.

name.description: Ad group name. No other ad group of the campaign may have it.

max_cpc.description: The most a click may cost, for the keywords that set no bid of their own. Used by campaigns that bid with MANUAL_CPC.

tools.name: update_ad_group
tools.description: Change an ad group: its name, its default bid, or its status. Only what you pass is changed. A removed ad group cannot be restored. Amounts are in the account's currency.

customer_id.description: Google Ads account ID, such as 123-456-7890, as returned by list_accounts.

ad_group_id.description: Ad group ID, as returned by list_ad_groups.

max_cpc.description: New most a click may cost.

tools.name: add_keywords
tools.description: Add keywords to an ad group of a Search campaign: the searches its ads show for, or with negative the searches they must not show for. Every keyword says how closely a search has to match it. Amounts are in the account's currency.

customer_id.description: Google Ads account ID, such as 123-456-7890, as returned by list_accounts.

ad_group_id.description: Ad group ID, as returned by list_ad_groups.

keywords.description: Keywords to add. EXACT matches searches with the same meaning, PHRASE searches that include that meaning, and BROAD searches related to it. max_cpc is the most a click may cost for this keyword, when the campaign bids with MANUAL_CPC.

negative.description: Add them as negative keywords, which take no max_cpc.

tools.name: update_keyword
tools.description: Change a keyword of an ad group: pause it, enable it, remove it, or set the most a click may cost for it. The text and match type of a keyword cannot be changed: remove it and add another. Amounts are in the account's currency.

customer_id.description: Google Ads account ID, such as 123-456-7890, as returned by list_accounts.

ad_group_id.description: Ad group ID, as returned by list_ad_groups.

criterion_id.description: Keyword ID, as returned by list_keywords.

max_cpc.description: New most a click may cost.

tools.name: create_responsive_search_ad
tools.description: Create a text ad in an ad group of a Search campaign. Google shows up to 3 of the headlines and 2 of the descriptions at a time, in the combinations that perform best, so each must make sense on its own and none may repeat another. Google reviews an ad before it shows.

customer_id.description: Google Ads account ID, such as 123-456-7890, as returned by list_accounts.

ad_group_id.description: Ad group ID, as returned by list_ad_groups.

path1.description: First part of the path shown after the domain, such as "shoes" in example.com/shoes/running. At most 15 characters.

path2.description: Second part of that path. Set it with path1.

tools.name: create_responsive_display_ad
tools.description: Create an image ad in an ad group of a Display campaign, from image assets and texts that Google assembles to fit each placement. It needs at least one landscape image (1.91:1, 600×314 pixels or more) and one square image (1:1, 300×300 or more): add images with create_image_upload_link and create_image_asset, or find them with list_assets. Google reviews an ad before it shows.

customer_id.description: Google Ads account ID, such as 123-456-7890, as returned by list_accounts.

ad_group_id.description: Ad group ID, as returned by list_ad_groups.

marketing_image_asset_ids.description: Landscape images (1.91:1, at least 600×314), by asset ID.

square_marketing_image_asset_ids.description: Square images (1:1, at least 300×300), by asset ID. With the landscape ones, at most 15.

square_logo_asset_ids.description: Square logos (1:1, at least 128×128), by asset ID.

wide_logo_asset_ids.description: Wide logos (4:1, at least 512×128), by asset ID. With the square ones, at most 5.

long_headline.description: The headline shown where there is room for a longer one.

business_name.description: The name of the advertiser, as the ad shows it.

tools.name: set_ad_status
tools.description: Enable, pause, or remove an ad. The texts and images of an ad cannot be changed here: create a new ad and pause or remove the old one. A removed ad cannot be restored.

customer_id.description: Google Ads account ID, such as 123-456-7890, as returned by list_accounts.

ad_group_id.description: Ad group ID, as returned by list_ad_groups.

ad_id.description: Ad ID, as returned by list_ads.

tools.name: create_image_upload_link
tools.description: Get a temporary link to upload one image, so that create_image_asset can add it to a Google Ads account. Send the file as the body of a PUT request to the link, for example with `curl -T banner.png "<url>"`, then pass `upload_id` to create_image_asset. The link takes one JPEG, PNG, or GIF file of at most 5 MB, without signing in, from anyone who has it, until it expires: use it yourself or give it to the user, and never post it anywhere else. An uploaded image can be used for 60 minutes.

filename.description: Name of the file, such as banner.png, without a folder.

content_type.description: Media type of the file, such as image/png. Defaults to the one of its extension.

expires_in_minutes.description: How long the link takes a file.

tools.name: create_image_asset
tools.description: Add an uploaded image to the assets of a Google Ads account, where ads can use it. Returns its asset ID and what Google Ads can use it as: a landscape image (1.91:1), a square image or logo (1:1), a wide logo (4:1), or a portrait image (4:5). An asset cannot be deleted or changed afterwards.

customer_id.description: Google Ads account ID, such as 123-456-7890, as returned by list_accounts.

upload_id.description: The upload_id create_image_upload_link returned, once the file was sent to its link.

name.description: Name of the asset in the account, such as "Spring sale banner". No other image asset may have it.

tools.name: add_campaign_images
tools.description: Show images beside the text ads of a Search campaign, from image assets of the account. They must be square (1:1, at least 300×300 pixels) or landscape (1.91:1, at least 600×314). Google reviews them, and only shows images for advertisers it has verified.

customer_id.description: Google Ads account ID, such as 123-456-7890, as returned by list_accounts.

campaign_id.description: Campaign ID, as returned by list_campaigns.

asset_ids.description: Image assets to show, by asset ID.
